thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P0 — runtime-hotpath queueing spike in prod us-west-2. Error rate and tail latency increasing. Auto-page to eng-oncall. https://incidents/redwood/6481234567
alex: On it, pulling traces and queue metrics now.
maria: 5xxs climbing, long queue depth on hotpath consumers. Top noisy tenants: fintech-ops, search-proto.
james: Current max_inflight per shard is 220. Recommend drop to 100 and enable priority shedding for background lanes to free slots.
leah: I can gate the big tenants with route caps while we mitigate. Suggest 40 rps for the noisy ones.
alex: Noted. I'm going to flip off semantic-retriever-v2 on hotpath — we've seen a backend fanout pattern. Going to toggle now.
incidents-bot: Status changed: acknowledged by alex. Assigned: alex, leah, james.
alex: retriever flag disabled :white_check_mark: backend QPS from hotpath down ~30% in the first window.
maria: CS: AcmeFin reporting timeouts ~45s and retry storms; they're impacted but data not lost yet.
james: Also want to reduce route timeout to 20s to fail-fast and free KV cache slots. Plan: change timeout + max_inflight + enable shedding.
james: Command I'm running: `infractl route update --route hotpath --timeout 20s --max_inflight 100 --enable-shedding=true`
leah: Applying tenant caps now: `infractl quota set --tenant fintech-ops --rps 40 && infractl quota set --tenant search-proto --rps 40`
alex: Tenant caps applied. Queue depth decreasing, 95th latency trending down.
cs-rep: CS update: reached out to AcmeFin and FinAnalytics. Both report degraded UX but no data loss. Asking for ETA.
james: ETA 10-15m to stabilize, continue watch on error-rate and queue depth.
maria: :eyes: shard-3 error rate still elevated, but traffic shaping is helping overall.
alex: Initiating soft-drain of shard-3 and rebalancing its routing slice to reduce hotpath load.
incidents-bot: Routing change executed: shard-3 soft-drain in progress.
leah: Planning handoff to night oncall @sam in ~25m. Sam, pls ack when you're ready to take on after I leave.
sam: Ack — I'll take over monitoring and follow the live mitigation checklist. DM me any context or runbooks.
alex: Leaving rollback notes in thread: re-enable semantic-retriever-v2 if backend stabilizes, restore tenant caps to previous values (200 rps), revert timeout to 60s.
maria: If total error count > 1000 after stabilization we open a postmortem. Otherwise we'll summarize mitigation steps and next actions. Thanks team :tada:
